name: HORSE
summary: Mixed-limit poker rotation cycling through Hold'em, Omaha Hi-Lo, Razz, Stud and Stud Hi-Lo.
rules_text: HORSE is played limit with a standard 52-card deck. Players compete for chips. The game type rotates, typically after one full orbit or a set time: H = limit Texas hold'em, O = limit Omaha hi-lo split eight-or-better, R = Razz lowball stud, S = limit seven-card stud high, E = limit seven-card stud hi-lo eight-or-better. Each segment is played by its normal poker rules with blinds or antes, bring-in, and limit betting rounds. Hole cards and some stud cards are private, community and up-cards are public. Best hand wins the pot, with hi-lo games splitting between best high and best qualifying low. In tournaments, players are eliminated when out of chips; rotation continues until one player remains.
rating_reason: Mixed poker variants, hidden hands, bidding, bluffing, strategic
